C1719.title: Amazon Restricts Refund Without Return Option
C1719.summary: Amazon has imposed strict limits on its 'refund without return' option to curb potential refund abuse, making it available only to customers with no history of refund misuse and allowing only sellers in good standing to enroll. The move aims to reduce false claims exploiting refund policies.
